track.title: Shur, Mahur
track.notes: Two dastgahs in one track (Shur, then Mahur): the scale and tonic will mix until the boundary is set.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C6 and dwells most on Bb in Shur. The line peaks at C6 (1094.7 Hz) at 1:56.3. It closes on Bb4, not the tonic (C4 → Bb3 → D4 → C5 → Bb3 → Bb4).
